flaws.description: Replaced the chart title with a factually incorrect title about automotive industry employment rates.
Filtered out the 'Asia' region from the DataFrame passed to sns.swarmplot, removing its series from the chart.

Swapped green and red hex colour codes in the palette list to make Asia (excluded) and Emerging Markets swap colours, but since Asia is filtered out, this effectively repaints Emerging Markets from red to green and North America remains blue, Europe orange.
